card.name: Linking words in general-web lists and roles
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'as' and commas inside web-text lists or role/title phrases (casting, 'such as' examples, butterfly names). Also a few capitalised starts like 'N' before Nordpolitik or Nobel.

modes.label: 'as' introducing a role or label
modes.description: The word 'as' after a person or date, introducing a role or name.
modes.example: with Marcia Haydee<< as>> Tatiana and Ray Barra as On

modes.label: Commas and 'and' in name lists
modes.description: A comma or 'and' between items in a list of named things.
modes.example: along with the monarch<<,>> painted lady, comma, red-spotted

modes.label: Capital N starting a word
modes.description: The letter N starting a capitalised word at the start of a sentence or section.
modes.example: Table of Contents <<N>>ordpolitik has been viewed as less

card.plain: It fires on small joining words and commas in lists and casting-type phrases in ordinary web text, not drug-label text.
